import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**Recommended solution:** archive a Bob-managed Gmail thread **once** when its last open watcher closes. Do not keep a standing “archived iff closed” loop.

The report is `research:202611/gmail_sync_archive_closed_tasks__grk.md` (snapshot `file:explicit:c64aa695331e07a84f768dda`).

Closing a mail task already ends the Gmail watch. Leaving that thread in the inbox is a second done-pile. Gmail archive (remove `INBOX`, keep `bob`, keep unread, keep the mail note) is the matching mailbox gesture. The requested biconditional is the part I would not ship: if Bob re-archives on every hourly sync, a recruiter reply that Gmail just restored is gone again within the hour.

**Adjustments I would make**

- One-shot, journaled as `gmail.archived`. A later reply may return to the inbox; Bob leaves it there.
- Predicate: enrolled + still labelled `bob` + still in `INBOX` + no open watchers. Cancel and delete count; several tasks must all leave the watch set.
- Opt-in `gmail.sync.archive_closed` (default off), Mac writer, `bob gmail login -s modify`. Compose cannot archive. Do not use gog `--gmail-scope full`.
- First enable previews the backlog; `--archive-backlog` is the only way to archive historical closed mail.
- Sync executes after filing and watch apply. Close is consent only (capture still makes zero Gmail calls). Reopen before the next `:07` run cancels the pending archive.
- Quiet cron still prints `✉ archived` rows and fires a desktop notification. Close-time Obsidian Notice names the consequence. `bob gmail restore` undoes the last batch.
- Keep the `bob` label. That is a different drain from bead `bob-cli-i4` (unlabel after file). Do not overload i4.

gog already has `gmail archive --thread` (since v0.25.0). Bob should call it with `--enable-commands-exact gmail.archive` and never with `--query`. This is a `feat(gmail)!:` contract break against today’s “never archives” sentence in `docs/gmail.md`.
